verses.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
verses.sm: ONA o atu lea o le fanauga »22 Isaraelu, ma latou to lauapi i le eleele laugatasi o Moapi, i le itu mai o Ioritana e fesagai ma Ieriko.

verses.en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Palako le atalii o Seporu mea uma na faia e Isaraelu i sa Amori.

verses.en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona matuā fefe lea o Moapi ona o le nuu, auā e toatele i latou ; ua atuatuvale foi Moapi ona o le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Moapi i toeaina o Mitiana, Anei e faaumatia e lenei vao tagata o mea uma ua vagavagaia i tatou, e pei ona ‘aina e le povi o le vao o le fanua. O Palako foi le atalii o Seporu, o le tupu ia o Moapi i ia ona po.

verses.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.sm: Ona aauina atu ai lea e ia o le sāvali ia Palaamo le atalii o Peoro, i Petoru o loo latalata ane i le vaitafe i le laueleele o lona nuu, e aami ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Faauta, ua o mai le tasi nuu mai Aikupito; faauta, ua ufitia le fogāeleele ia i latou ; o loo nonofo foi i latou o feagai ma a‘u.

verses.en: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.sm: O lenei, se‘i e maliu mai, ia e fetuuina lenei nuu mo a‘u, auā e sili lo latou malosi i lo‘u; atonu ou te mafai ai ona fafasi ia te i latou, ma tutuli ia te i latou ai le nuu; auā ua ou iloa o le e te faamanuia ua manuia lea, ma le e te fetuuina ua malaia lea.

verses.en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.sm: Ona o ai lea o toeaina o Moapi, ma toeaina o Mitiana, sa i o latou lima foi o totogi o togafiti a le taulāitu ; ona oo atu lea o i latou ia Palaamo, ma fai atu ia te ia o upu a Palako.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, Ia outou tofafā iina i le po nei, ou te au mai ai se upu ia te outou e fetalaia mai e Ieova ia te au ; ona nonofo ai lea o alii o Moapi ma Palaamo.

verses.en: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.sm: Ona afio mai lea o le Atua ia Palaamo, ua faapea mai, O ai ea ia tagata o ia te oe ?

verses.en: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o Palaamo i le Atua, O Palako le atalii o Seporu, o le tupu o Moapi, ua ia feau mai ia te au, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua o mai le tasi nuu mai Aikupito, ua ufitia ai le fogāeleele ; o lenei, ina e sau ia, ia e fetuuina i latou mo a‘u ; atonu ou te mafai ai ona tau ma i latou, ma tutuli ese ia te i Atua ia Palaamo,

verses.en: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.sm: Aua tou te o ma i latou; aua foi e te fetuu i le nuu ; auā ua faamanuia i latou.

verses.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.sm: Oua tulai lea o Palaamo i le taeao, ua faapea atu i alii mai ia Palako, Ina maliu atu ia i lo outou nuu, auā e le mafai ia Ieova ona tuu ia te au e o ma outou.

verses.en: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o alii o Moapi, ma latou o atu ia Palako, ua faapea atu, E le mafai Palaamo ona matou o mai.

verses.en: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.sm: Ona toe aauina atu ai lea e Palako o alii e sili ona toatele ma le mamalu i e na muamua.

verses.en: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.sm: Ua latou oo ia Palaamo, ma latou faapea atu ia te ia, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Palako le atalii o Seporu, Ou te aioi atu ia te oe, aua ne‘i taofia oe, a ia e maliu mai lava ia te au;

verses.en: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.sm: auā ou te matuā faamalualiiina oe ; o mea uma foi e te fai mai ai ia te au ou te faia lava; o lenei, se‘i e maliu mai lava, ia e fetuuina lenei nuu mo a‘u.

verses.en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Palaamo, ua faapea mai i auauna a Palako, Afai e foaiina mai e Palako ia te au o ario ma auro e tumu ai lona fale, ou te le mafaia ona soli le afioga a Ieova lo‘u Atua e fai se niea itiiti, po o se mea tele.

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia nonofo outou iina i lenei po, seia ou iloa pe se a se tOe mea e fetalai mai ai Ieova ia te au.

verses.en: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.sm: Ona afio mai lea o le Atua ia Palaamo i le po, ua fetalai mai ia te ia, Afai ua o mai ia tagata e valaau ia te oe, ia e tulai, tou te o ma i latou; a e tau lava o le upu ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, ia e faia lea.

verses.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o Palaamo i le taeao, ma faanofoa lana asini, ua o faatasi ma alii o Moapi.

verses.en: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.sm: Ona tupu ai lea o le toasa o le Atua ina ua alu o ia ; ua tu mai foi le agelu a Ieova i le ala e tetee ia te ia. Ua tietie o ia i lana asini, sa ia te ia foi ana auauna e toalua.

verses.en: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le asini le agelu a Ieova ua tu i le ala, sa i lona lima lana pelu ua se‘i, ona ‘alo ese ai lea o le asini i le ala, ua ui i le vao; ona sasa ai lea o le asini e Palaamo e faafoi ia te ia i le ala.

verses.en: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.sm: A ua tu le agelu a Ieova i le ala va apiapi i tovine, sa taitasi itu ala aupa.

verses.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le asini le agelu a Ieova, ona mia lea, e ia o ia i le aupa, na omia foi le vae o Palaamo i le aupa; ona toe sasa lea o ia i ai.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.sm: Ona toe alu atu lea o le agelu a Ieova, ma tu mai i le mea va apiapi, e le o i ai se ala e ‘alo ese ai i le itu taumatau, po o le itu tauagavale.

verses.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le asini le agelu a Ieova, ona taoto ai lea o ia i lalo o Palaamo; ona tupu ai lea o le ita o Palaamo, ma na sasa le asini i le laau.

verses.en: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.sm: Ona faagaganaina lea e ieova o le asini, i le ua fai mai o ia ia Palaamo, Se a ea se mea ua ou faia ia te oe ua e sasa faatolu mai ai ia te au ?

verses.en: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Palaamo i le asini, Auā ua e faaonoono mai ia te au ; se anoa ana i lo‘u lima se pelu po o penei ua ou fasimatea nei oe.

verses.en: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le asini ia Palaamo, E le o lau asini ea a‘u nei, ua e tietie ai talu ona e maua o alu ua oo mai i le aso nei ? o la‘u masani ea ona fai faapea ia te oe ? Ona faapea atu ai lea o ia, E leai lava.

verses.en: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.sm: Ona faapupulaina lea e Ieova o mata o Palaamo, ona iloa ai lea e ia o le agelu a Ieova o loo tu i le ala, ua i lona lima lana pelu ua se‘i; ona ifo ai lea o ia ua faapaūfao.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le agelu a ieova ia te ia, Se a ea le mea ua e sasa faatolu ai lau asini? faauta, o a‘u nei ua ou sau e tetee ia te oe, auā ua leaga lava lou ala i o‘u luma.

verses.en: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.sm: Na iloa mai foi a‘u e le asini, ma ‘alo ese faatolu ia te au; ana le ‘alo ese o ia ia te au, po o penei ua ou fasiotia oe, a e faasao ia te ia.

verses.en: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Palaamo i le agelu a Ieova, Ua ou agasala, auā ou te lei iloa ua e tu mai oe i le ala e tetee ia te au ; o lenei, afai ua leaga ia te oe le mea ua ou faia, ou te toe foi atu lava a‘u.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le agelu a Ieova ia Palaamo, O pea ia outou ma na tagata, a e peitai tau o upu ou te fai atu ai ia te oe e te tautala a‘i. Ona o ai lea o Palaamo ma alii mai ia Palako.

verses.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Palako ua sau Palaamo, ona alu ai lea o ia e faafetaiai ia te ia i le tasi aai o Moapi, o le nuu tupito lea, o loo i le tuaoi o Arinona.

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Palako ia Palaamo, Na ou le matuā aauina atu ea nisi ia te oe e aami ia te oe ? se a ea le mea na e le sau ai ia te au ? e moni ea ou te le mafaia ona faamalualiiina oe ?

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Palaamo ia Palako, Faauta, ua ou sau ia te oe ; o lenei, ou te mafaia ea se upu e tasi ona fai atu ? o le upu e tuu mai e le Atua i lo‘u gutu, ou te fai atu ai lava.

verses.en: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.
verses.sm: Ona o ai lea o Palaamo ma Palako, ua la oo atu i Kiriatausota.

verses.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.sm: Ua fasi foi e Palako o povi ma mamoe, ua ia avatu foi le feau ia Palaamo ma alii sa ia te ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, ona ave ai lea e Palako ia Palaamo, ma la o ae ma ia i mea maualuluga a Paala ina ia iloa atu ai e ia o le nuu ia oo i e aupito mamao. O taulaga na osia e Palaamo, ma
